native_form.query: SELECT TO_VARCHAR(o.STORE_ID) AS store_id, MAX(s.STORE_NAME) AS store_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.PARTITIONAL_DATE) AS mon, MAX(o.CREATED_AT) AS max_at, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM DATAMART.ORDERS o JOIN DATAMART.STORES s ON s.STORE_ID = TO_VARCHAR(o.STORE_ID) WHERE s.SI_GUN_GU IN ('성북구','성동구') AND o.PARTITIONAL_DATE >= DATEADD('month', -3, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1,3 ORDER BY 1,3
